# Noble Father Creations

> Free books and tools by Shae Stovell for seeing manipulation, coercive control and power clearly, and for staying safe: field guides for women, kids, festival-goers and families, an investigation of where $50 trillion went, a sourced record of power inside 34 faiths, and the Pattern Decoder (310 named tactics). Everything is free to read, offline-friendly, and licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (share with credit; no selling; no edited copies).

Every book below has a contents page and one plain HTML page per chapter, so you can cite the exact chapter. Each page carries a short notice: these are educational resources, not legal, medical or psychological advice.

## Books with chapter pages

- [The Sacred Divide](https://noblefathercreations.com/faith): A free, sourced record of how institutional power works inside 34 religious traditions, each held to the same standard: leadership, money, disclosure, what leaving costs, and 30 control techniques graded with evidence. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/faith
- [Playground Protectors](https://noblefathercreations.com/children): A free illustrated book for kids ages 5 and up about tricky people: 28 missions that teach children to spot manipulation ("that didn't happen", guilt trips, secrets, exclusion), with Power-Ups to say and do, and notes for the grown-ups reading along. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/children/contents
- [The Sovereign Divine Feminine](https://noblefathercreations.com/feminine): A free field guide to psychological manipulation for women: 42 chapters naming the tactics (DARVO, fog, credibility theft, the digital leash, post-separation control) with counter-moves, safety planning and identity repair. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/feminine/contents
- [The Fractal](https://noblefathercreations.com/fractal): A free book on one manipulation cycle that runs at every scale: thirty techniques, from love bombing to learned helplessness, traced through religion, politics, healthcare, housing and 22 more parts of life, in a person, an institution and a civilization. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/fractal/contents
- [The Fracture](https://noblefathercreations.com/fracture): A free twelve-episode reading edition on where roughly $50 trillion went over 43 years: who received it, the 30 pipelines and six loops that move it, and what changes at every scale. 195 public-record sources. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/fracture/contents
- [The Festie Codex](https://noblefathercreations.com/wook): A free field manual for the festival scene: 33 chapters on spotting manipulators, predators and coercive groups at festivals and raves, plus harm reduction, consent, drug-checking, bad trips, the next twelve hours after an assault, and recovery. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/wook/contents
- [The Festie Bible](https://noblefathercreations.com/festival): Twenty-one free field guides to psychological safety at festivals, one for each corner of the scene: women, men, first-timers, sober, LGBTQ+, BIPOC, disabled, artists, vendors, crew, harm reduction and more. 270 scenarios with the tells, what is happening, and what to say. Contents: https://noblefathercreations.com/festival/contents
